correctness.rationale: The nonzero-sum normalization is bijective on ordered pairs and factors the collision equation into z²=w² and the stated quartic. The diagonal contributes 2q−1 and exactly B_q points of overlap; the zero-sum slice contributes 1+g(q−1). On the conic in U=z²,V=w², the unweighted contribution is q−δ, each single character contributes δS3, and grouping by U+V gives the double character contribution −1+δS4. The discriminants of the displayed elliptic polynomials are 968000 and 33000000, nonzero in scope; the monic quartic has two rational points at infinity, so S4=−1−b_q, not −b_q. In characteristic 11 the two nonsingular conics have q−δ points apiece and four intersections; B_q=8 and δ=(−1)^r. The smooth quartic has 2(1+δ) points at infinity and no affine singularities in the generic range: a nonzero affine coordinate pair at a critical point forces z²=w²=−5, and a single nonzero coordinate forces its square to be −15/2, neither giving F=0 in scope. Orthogonality gives energy divided by q² for the fourth moment with counting measure.
